cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my complaint in bold like yours. Official now. Did being called office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Bold marks the bits I haven't read. Have you actually sent a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, ready to read. It's still a draft. Tell me how you felt before I send anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I'm replacing 'unprofessional' with 'I went home and cried'.
